slides.title: 10 Google reviews in 30 days
body: The rule-following way that actually works.

slides.title: Get your review link
body: Business Profile → "Ask for reviews" → copy link. Save it in your phone.

slides.title: Ask within 24 hours
body: Right after the job, while they're happy and it's fresh.

slides.title: Ask every customer
body: Not just the happy ones. Google's rules ban picking who to ask.

slides.title: Never pay for reviews
body: No discounts or gifts for reviews. It breaks Google's rules and the FTC's rule on reviews.

slides.title: Reply to every review
body: A short, personal thank-you shows future customers you care.

slides.title: How many do you have?
body: Get your free visibility score. Link in bio.
